*Potentially missing details on exchange cost scaling, special types of exchange (Party, blind, flashbang, disco)}}

[[File:Arcanist Button.png|frameless|left]]
Arcanist unlocks at Obelisk 70. You damage Essence Blocks to collect Essence, run Altars to convert Essence into Runes, cast spells to gain boosts for the main game or within Arcanist, and Exchange resources with wizards for Orbs.

{{Clear|left}}
==In-game description==
<div style="margin:auto;font-size:0.9em">
{{Quote
|quote = 
Arcanist is still in development! Things may be inaccessible and a bunch more upgrades are WIP!

Essence - Battle with Essence blocks to farm.. Essence! Essence can be made into Runes, used to buy Upgrades and traded to Wizards for Orbs!

Shiny Blocks give Bonus Essence! Brittle Blocks spawn with lower Health!

Altar - Altars are used to Craft Essence into Runes! Runes are used to Cast Spells and buy Upgrades!

Spells - Use Mana and Runes to cast Spells! Spells can level up to be stronger, rank up their Potency to make them ever stronger!

Every Spell Level and Potency Rank increases the Spell effect by 5%, multiplicative with each other!

Spells can be unlocked from various systems throughout the game! Spell Duration depletes in real time!

Exchange - The Wizards are willing to exchange Orbs for your Currencies!

Reaching Orb Trading Milestones will allow new Wizards to appear!
}}</div>

==Essence==

The arcanist menu revolves around attacking Essence Blocks to generate Essence which is then converted into runes by your runners.

Each of the Essence blocks has it's own values for armour and HP, progressively scaling the later the essence. New Essences also add new debuffs to the player.

On this tab of the menu your miner battles Essence Blocks to collect Essence. You can view Player Stats and Essence Stats.  Essence Blocks have their own card. 

Upgrades are on this tab typically affect the Player Stats and Essence Stats meaning you can damage Essence Blocks more effectively.

==Altars==
On this tab you run Altars to convert Essence into Runes. Unlocking new Altars requires runes from the previous Altar. You can use Orbs to upgrade Altars to get more Runes. Altars can be paused at any time in order to preserve Essence. Altars have their own card.

The first Altar is unlocked right away, but must be unpaused before it does anything.

==Spells==
On this tab you cast spells, which give a passive and active effect to the main game and/or Arcanist. Spells are ranked up using Runes, and cost resources to cast. Spells have their own card. 

Increasing a spell's Potency Rank improves its Passive, Active, Duration, and Level Chance by the formula 1 + PotencyLevel * 5%.

A spell's level chance may be calculated as 1 in (Spell Level + 1) * 50 / Potency Effect / Spell Level Up Mult.

Increasing a spell's Spell Level increases its Passive and Active effects by the formula 1 + SpellLevel * 5%.

The Passive and Active effects from Potency Levels and Spell Levels multiply with each other.

==Exchange==
On this tab you can exchange resources with Wizards to trade for Orbs. These resources can come from Arcanist like Essence and Runes, or any aspect of the main game like items, prestige points, gems, bars, veins, stars, fish, archaeology fragments. Starting out there are 6 wizards offering Exchanges, and you can refresh them every 2 hours. Refreshes must be done manually, and they will bank with a cap of 15 banked refreshes.

Exchange Upgrades can boost Exchanges, other tabs of Arcanist, or the main game.

==Satchel==
The Satchel will show the amount of all Essence, Runes, and Orbs owned. The Satchel can be opened while on any tab of Arcanist and does not require being held to stay open. This makes the satchel a useful way to see all currencies when making decisions on buying upgrades.
